author: Nelev
body:
## Summary
- A new conversation opens with three assistant messages instead of one: who Medas is, what the patient can do (ask about their record, upload a PDF, ask for a PDF export of the conversation), and a prompt.
- `greeting_texts` replaces `greeting_text` and feeds both the `GET /` preview and the seeded conversation, so the two can't drift. The seed is still a single insert (now four rows).
- `POST /ask` and `POST /documents` return five turns when they start a conversation (three greeting turns, the question, the answer).
- The UI fallback in `page.tsx` mirrors the copy for when init fails.
- Message text is 13px instead of 14px, overridden in the chat row so the shared bubble primitive is untouched.
- README and CLAUDE.md updated to match. Conversations stored before this keep their one-line greeting.

## Test plan
- [x] `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q` (178 passed)
- [x] `yarn lint && yarn format:check && yarn tsc --noEmit && yarn test` (69 passed)
- [ ] Open a new conversation in the app and check the three messages and the font size
